context: The helper stands at the shelf with the box open. All screens, both Duo sizes and themes: https://claude.ai/artifact/F2pNQsrFg6fDSqFQzKpasU (picks page) and designs/d4-banchi-phone/ on the roadmap branch. All cards, orders and buyers are made up.

options.how: The phone gives one number: the card's place from the front.
options.label: Count from the front
options.lose: Counting 108 cards by hand is slow and easy to get wrong.

options.how: The phone names the nearest divider and a short count from it.
options.label: Count from a divider
options.lose: Needs a divider about every 100 cards, named the same on the phone and in the box.

options.gain: No counting; looks like the box.
options.how: The phone shows photos of the cards on each side.
options.label: Show the two neighbours
options.lose: Still needs a start point; a neighbour that sold breaks the hint.

ref: d4 (first design test: a blind Banchi phone app)
title: Banchi phone app: how does the helper find the card inside the box?
why: Designer and reviewer both pick B, with C's neighbour photos as the fallback.
